say:2:1110216002:1.text: Those who look down on the Uru Clan think they're tough because they have more members...
say:2:1110216002:1.source_cn: 那些看不起乌尔氏族的家伙，只不过仗着人多势众而已……

say:3:1110216003:1.text: Alright, calm down. After talking to them for a bit, they told us how to participate in the trial, didn't they?
say:3:1110216003:1.source_cn: 行啦行啦！好好沟通之后，他们不也告诉我们参加试炼的方法了吗？

say:4:1110216004:0.text: As long as we register and pass the three trials, we'll be qualified to participate in the Warsong Festival on behalf of the Uru Clan.
say:4:1110216004:0.source_cn: 只要报名后，通过三次试炼，咱们就能代表乌尔氏族获得参加...

say:5:1110216005:1.text: That's right. The outcome of these three trials will determine whether or not we can honor our promise to our father and make a name for our clan at Mars Peak.
say:5:1110216005:1.source_cn: 没错——能否完成与老爹的约定，在战神峰打响氏族之名，全...

choice_prompt:6:1110216005.text: That's right. The outcome of these three trials will determine whether or not we can honor our promise to our father and make a name for our clan at Mars Peak.
choice_prompt:6:1110216005.source_cn: 没错——能否完成与老爹的约定，在战神峰打响氏族之名，全都取决于这三次试炼的结果。

say:8:1110216006:1.text: That's right! We found out that Magister Merlin will also be at Mars Peak. Since we're going to the same place, let's work together along the way!

say:8:1110216006:1.male: That's right! We found out that Magister Merlin will also be at Mars Peak. Since we're going to the same place, let's work together along the way!

say:9:1110216008:1.text: Yes, let's work together! I'm all about working together!
say:9:1110216008:1.source_cn: 齐心协力！好耶，我最喜欢这个词了！

say:11:1110216010:0.text: Refusing help... Soren, you wouldn't be so rude, would you?
say:11:1110216010:0.source_cn: 要拒绝帮手……索恩，你不会这么不上道吧？

say:12:1110216011:1.text: Did I say I would refuse? I just want to show everyone that the Uru Clan is not weak.
say:12:1110216011:1.source_cn: 我可没那么说——得让那些人看看，乌尔氏族可不是势单力薄。

say:13:1110216012:1.text: Thank you so much, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! With you helping the Uru Clan, we can face the first trial with confidence!
